verdicts.reason: A has an unwanted collision: the 'Read 2,400 Reviews' button sits right against 'MAYA R., VERIFIED BUYER' on the same baseline, and the quote mark floats far above the headline. The left ~150px is empty, and the logo sits on a cropped circle that has drifted away from the bottle it used to frame. B reads left to right with even spacing (logo, quote, bottle, CTA), but the attribution is set nearly as large as the headline, which weakens the hierarchy. Its bottle has also lost its circle backdrop, and the CTA overlaps the circle cropped at the right edge.
